beats.hindi_tts: Hammer and Hanging Man share identical visual shape, yet their implications are exact opposites.
beats.en_subtitle: Hammer and Hanging Man share identical visual shape, yet their implications are exact opposites.

leftColumn.title: The Hammer
leftColumn.subtitle: Appears after downtrend
bullets: Small real body at the upper end of range
Lower shadow at least twice real body length
Signals aggressive intraday demand absorbing panic

beats.en_narration: Hammer and Hanging Man share identical visual shape, yet their implications are exact opposites.

beats.hindi_tts: The Hanging Man at tops warns that bears possess enough ammunition to trigger sharp intraday breaks.
beats.en_subtitle: The Hanging Man at tops warns that bears possess enough ammunition to trigger sharp intraday breaks.

leftColumn.title: The Hammer
leftColumn.subtitle: Appears after downtrend
bullets: Small real body at upper end
Lower shadow ≥ 2x body height
Bullish bottom reversal signal

rightColumn.title: The Hanging Man
rightColumn.subtitle: Appears after uptrend
bullets: Identical small body and long lower shadow
Shows bears breached previous impenetrable support
Needs bearish confirmation candle next day

beats.en_narration: The Hanging Man at tops warns that bears possess enough ammunition to trigger sharp intraday breaks.

beats.hindi_tts: Never act on a Hanging Man alone: confirmation via a lower close the next session is mandatory.
beats.en_subtitle: Never act on a Hanging Man alone: confirmation via a lower close the next session is mandatory.

leftColumn.title: Hammer Rule
leftColumn.subtitle: Bullish validation
bullets: Color matters little (green is slightly stronger)
Buy signal confirmed above hammer high

rightColumn.title: Hanging Man Rule
rightColumn.subtitle: Bearish requirement
bullets: High risk of bull trap if bought blindly
Close below hanging body triggers short setup

beats.en_narration: Never act on a Hanging Man alone: confirmation via a lower close the next session is mandatory.

leftColumn.title: Dark Cloud Cover
leftColumn.subtitle: Top reversal pattern

Closes deeply into Day 1 body (> 50% penetration)

beats.hindi_tts: The Piercing Line is its bottom counterpart: gapping down below the red candle, then closing past the 50% midpoint.
beats.en_subtitle: The Piercing Line is its bottom counterpart: gapping down below the red candle, then closing past the 50% midpoint.

leftColumn.title: Dark Cloud Cover
leftColumn.subtitle: Top reversal pattern
bullets: Day 1: Strong bullish green body
Day 2: Closes below 50% midpoint of Day 1
Rejection of higher gap open

rightColumn.title: Piercing Line
rightColumn.subtitle: Bottom reversal pattern
bullets: Day 1: Long black/red candle in downtrend
Day 2: Gaps down to new low, then aggressive rally
Must close above 50% midpoint of Day 1 body

beats.en_narration: The Piercing Line is its bottom counterpart: gapping down below the red candle, then closing past the 50% midpoint.

beats.hindi_tts: If the close fails to pierce the 50% midpoint, Japanese chartists discard it as incomplete.
beats.en_subtitle: If the close fails to pierce the 50% midpoint, Japanese chartists discard it as incomplete.

leftColumn.title: The 50% Midpoint Rule
leftColumn.subtitle: Murphy's Non-Negotiable Test
bullets: Penetration < 50% = Incomplete Dark Cloud (Weak)
Penetration 100% = Bearish Engulfing (Stronger)

rightColumn.title: Piercing Threshold
rightColumn.subtitle: Bottom Reversal Test
bullets: Must clear 50% mark of prior black candle
High volume on green day validates institutional entry

beats.en_narration: If the close fails to pierce the 50% midpoint, Japanese chartists discard it as incomplete.

ui_state.question: A stock rallies 25% over two weeks. At the peak, a candle forms with a tiny real body and a lower shadow 3x the body height. Alex calls it a Hammer and buys immediately. What critical mistake did Alex make?
ui_state.answer: Alex ignored trend context: a small body with long lower shadow after an uptrend is a Hanging Man (bearish warning), not a Hammer (bullish bottom). Moreover, he failed to wait for next-day bearish confirmation before acting.
